instruction:
Fix `plugins/catalog/src/components/CatalogEntityPage/useEntityFromUrl.test.tsx` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. `yarn tsc` fails with 1 error, which blocks the project's combined check (`CI=true yarn test ... && yarn tsc && yarn lint:all`):

  plugins/catalog/src/components/CatalogEntityPage/useEntityFromUrl.test.tsx:214:11 - error TS6133: 'result' is declared but its value is never read.

  214     const { result } = renderHook(

In that test the hook's states are captured by pushing into `recordedStatuses` inside the renderHook callback, and the assertions read `recordedStatuses` — so the destructured `result` is genuinely unused.

Fix minimally: drop the unused binding, i.e. call `renderHook(...)` without destructuring `result` (keep the call and all its arguments exactly as they are). If any OTHER test in this file destructures `result` and does use it, leave those untouched — fix only the unused one(s) that TypeScript flags.

Change nothing else. Keep all tests and their intentions exactly: no extra request when the ref resolves directly; redirect preserving sub-path, query and fragment; unknown ref left on the not-found path; resolution attempted at most once per ref; the no-flash case asserting the hook never reports {loading:false, hasEntity:false, hasError:false} for a stale ref that will resolve; and the case asserting loading is RELEASED when resolution settles unresolved. Keep both catalogApiRef and errorApiRef registered. Keep `screen`/`findBy*` usage, add no test IDs, and keep the Apache 2.0 header with year 2026 unchanged.

Acceptance: `yarn tsc` reports ZERO errors and `CI=1 yarn test plugins/catalog` passes with ZERO failures.

The file's current text is under Inputs, marked "current text"; your edits apply to exactly that text.

## Answer
Return ONLY a JSON object {"path": "plugins/catalog/src/components/CatalogEntityPage/useEntityFromUrl.test.tsx", "edits": [{"search": "<text copied exactly from the current text>", "replace": "<its replacement>"}]} with no other text. Each search must appear exactly once in the current text; the edits apply in order.
If the file does not exist yet, or the change rewrites most of it, return {"path": "plugins/catalog/src/components/CatalogEntityPage/useEntityFromUrl.test.tsx", "content": "<the complete file>"} instead.
